body: When you are tired, disappointed, or bracing for bad news, an uneasy feeling can easily start masquerading as a hard fact. When the Moon squares Neptune, emotional ambiguity and sensitivity blur together, turning a delayed text, a vague response, or a strange shift in tone into definitive proof of whatever outcome you fear most. Your intuition might be picking up on real friction, but anxiety is dangerously skilled at filling blank space with worst-case scenarios. Take the emotional signal seriously without letting it write a final conclusion before the facts are actually in.
